lessons: No drinks: lattes, tea, chai, lassi, golden milk and the like were all deleted as not appetising.
No desserts, sweet kueh, pancakes, crepes, custards, puddings, egg cakes or sweet porridge: all deleted as not appetising.

No plain side of one vegetable (blanched broccoli, green bean gomaae, cabbage poriyal): deleted as not appetising. A recipe is a proper, hearty, colourful savoury dish someone would want to eat as a meal.
No deep-frying, fritters or battered food: deleted as 'no fry'.
Every step written out: a recipe with too few steps was deleted as 'missing steps'. At least 4 steps, and every ingredient is used in a step.

Every ingredient clear and familiar: generic 'vegetable stock', two vegetables in one line ('Broccoli & bok choy') and jicama (bangkuang) were deleted as unclear or unknown. One named food per line, by its everyday name.
No onion, garlic or any of the five pungent vegetables (the owner's rule since 17 Oct 2026).
